correctness.rationale: The grounded rim Laplacian T=(t+2)I-S-S^{-1} is positive definite for all n>=3,t>0. The periodic positive Green kernel g_k=(rho^k+rho^{n-k})/[sqrt(t(t+4))(1-rho^n)] solves Tg=e_0 and decreases to k=floor(n/2). The exact signed spoke/rim projection columns have absolute sums A=1+2sqrt(t)(g0-gm) and B=2(1-t*g0)+2sqrt(t)(g0-gm), exchanged for I-Q; symmetry equates induced l1/linfty norms. Their difference 1-2t*g0 and Fourier eigenvalue formula make the half-level unique in t. The closed Green formula makes tau_n strictly increasing, with tau3=1,tau4=sqrt(5)-1 and limit 4/3. Expanding g0,gm proves the common parity-dependent O_t(rho^n) asymptotic. Independent exact SymPy incidence/projection matrices checked 12 (n,t) configurations, all columns; the source script was read, not executed. Critical hypothesis: unweighted coordinate norm of square-root-conductance-normalized Euclidean projection, NOT a minimum projection over all maps.
